tools.name: merge_hdr
tools.description: Merge bracketed exposures (2-9 workspace photos of one scene, RAW or JPEG/PNG/WebP) into one high-dynamic-range photo: MTB translation alignment, exposure ratios measured from the frames, a hat-weighted merge in linear light, optional deghosting. By default writes an Atelier document (.atelier) next to the first photo whose layer develops the merge as a float32 linear source (stored as a 32-bit float TIFF beside it, values above 1.0 kept); an output ending .dng writes a 16-bit linear DNG (camera colour matrix) instead. tools.name: refine_edge
tools.description: Select and mask: refines the current selection edge into a soft matte for hair, fur and fine edges. A trimap is built from the selection (band pixels either side of its edge are unknown; default 12) and the unknown band is solved by the on-device matting model (ViTMatte small) when it is downloaded, else classically (local foreground and background colour estimates cleaned by a colour guided filter of radius and eps). method: auto (model when downloaded, default), model (answers unsupported naming the download when absent) or classical. Pixels outside the band keep their selection values.
